explanation: Good things or benefits that God gives to people, often as a result of obedience to His commands.
Negative consequences or punishments that God imposes on people when they do not follow His commands.
To obey or follow instructions and rules given by an authority, in this case God's commands.
To fail to follow or break instructions and rules given by an authority, in this case God's commands.
Persons or groups who are in conflict with or oppose another person or group; here it refers to Israel's enemies.
The area or territory that God promised to give His people, in this case the land of Canaan.
The spiritual realm where God and angels dwell, also used as a metaphor for God's presence and blessing.
The physical world and planet we live on, also used as a metaphor for human life and existence.
